name: microduck-policy
$comment: The microduck with the policy interface (joint targets and gain in, sensors out), for the FMU export.

annotations.text: **microduck for a policy.** 14 joint targets and the servo gain in (the export inputs), the joint angles and rates, the trunk's gyro, orientation, position and projected gravity and the sole loads out: what velstand.onnx reads and writes at 50 Hz. Rigid joints carry the servo armature (XL330Rigid: rigid gear, no backlash), the soles start loaded at HOME, the trunk, head and shins have bumper points. In simulation the targets hold HOME and step to a 15 mm squat at 0.3 s (no policy: HOME tips forward, as in microduck-stand); the FMU takes them from the host.

parameters.name: kp_fw
parameters.description: XL330 Position P Gain register (robotd gain 200; standing 0.8x, limp 50)

parameters.name: i_limit
parameters.description: Firmware current limit (BAM/training 1.75 A; impact-guard firmware on the robot 1.0 A)

parameters.name: t_latency
parameters.description: Command latency, goal written to goal applied (a multiple of 5 ms)

parameters.name: v_bat
parameters.description: Supply voltage (2S Li-ion: 8.2 V full, 7.4 V nominal, 6.6 V empty under load)

parameters.name: k_motor
parameters.description: Torque constant at the horn, also the back-EMF constant (BAM XL330 M6 fit)

parameters.name: r_motor
parameters.description: Winding plus driver resistance (BAM XL330 M6 fit)

parameters.name: armature
parameters.description: Rotor and gears reflected to the horn (BAM XL330 M6 fit); the rotor inertia of XL330 is armature/288.4^2, the joint of XL330Rigid carries it as Ja

options.text: The robot that velstand.onnx drives in the browser demo, run here by itself: the servos hold HOME and the legs step to a squat at 0.3 s. Without a policy HOME tips forward. The FMU of this model takes the joint targets and the gain from the host instead. A run takes a few minutes.
